answer: Budget: one TEE attestation per identity, 40 ms each, and a grade diluted by 0.5 for every peer that disagrees. Run 300 clones on one attestation service and the disagreement rate climbs to 60 percent, halving each payout. Duplicates are caught by replay, so renaming the falcon account buys nothing. At the vertex of the dilution curve you pay 2x the attestation cost for 0.5x the reward, and the plume of new ids thins to the honest rate.
